That night he wrote a reply, sealed it in the same bottle, and waited for the next high tide.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的倦意里。高楼窗灯稀疏，像未熄的星。街道空荡，清洁车缓缓驶过，卷起落叶。便利店透出暖光，店员打着哈欠。高架桥上偶有车声，海风穿巷，带着潮气。墙角海棠静开，花瓣沾着夜露。送奶车铃叮地划破寂静，天边泛白。城市在醒来前轻叹，把未完成的梦藏进楼群。","w03":"- Imagine a story that tells the same story again, but with a smaller problem each time.\n- Every time the problem gets small enough, you stop and give a simple answer.\n- Then each smaller story hands its answer back to the one before it, like nested boxes opening one by one."}
